Notifications that pop up as a banner

Messages and other everyday notifications show as a card on the island instead of the stock banner. Only a notification the system would have shown as a banner becomes a card, so an app whose pop-up or sound is turned off in the phone notification settings gets no card unless silent notifications are included. Calls, alarms, media, live activities and verification codes have their own settings.

Changes save immediately. This preview uses the island renderer with a solid backdrop; system background blur depends on your device.
Reduce blur and animated effects to lighten rendering work.

Content blur is replaced by a crossfade. Card background blur becomes a solid black fill. Music effects use a static album-colour tint and still artwork. Waveforms become static and audio analysis stops. Animated icons use their settled frame while real state, including battery charge, stays current. Continuous animation is limited to 30 fps; touch feedback and expansion/collapse can use up to 60 fps.\n\nYour individual settings are kept and apply again when this mode is off. Notifications, calls, timers and music controls keep working. This option is off by default.
Auto shows an outline only when contrast between the pill and the actual background is low.
A shared glow around compact pills, following the music session by default.
0%: static · 50%: normal · 100%: strongest. The preview simulates music; brightness is adjusted separately.
All compact pills use the same vivid album colours as the music waveform. Turn off to use the selected colour source.

While a music session exists, all compact pills share its colours and sound response. Pausing makes the glow faint; ending the session fades the last album colours out smoothly. Theme and separate colours are preserved when switching modes.
Low-performance mode currently disables the glow. Your choices are preserved.

Choose the classic brightness slider or an expanding beam. Tap the flashlight to toggle power and drag the curved control to adjust brightness.
Open one activity at a time with coordinated blur and motion. Swipe sideways to switch between all activities. Swipe up to hide all pills, then pull down near the camera hole to show them again.
Watch a pill unfold smoothly into a card. Swipe sideways to browse your activities.
Adjust brightness by dragging the expanding beam. Tap the flashlight graphic to turn it smoothly on or off.

Swipe up, the way you mean it
Flick the small pill up to hide it. Swipe an open card up to fold it back. Faster swipes react faster.
